title: 第24章 焦虑第25章 吃兽人怎么了
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
最近这些天里，林恩都在写自己的《史莱姆从去毒到拉线做成布匹全过程建立工厂》计划书。
林恩潇潇洒洒的写了好几页，每天晚上有空就写到了深夜。
这几天可把人累化了，好在当年自己什么都玩。
有工业经济的维三，打仗的四个心脏，外太空的群星，中世纪的可以娶自己女儿的十字，中世纪到近代的欧陆，还有城市规模的天际。
以及全战，骑砍这些微操的游戏。
冰气时代这个刁民西方政治游戏。
让林恩什么都懂一点。
加上这辈子身为贵族，实打实的被从小培养过政治管理能力。
当初设计阿宁斯贝城的时候就有做了城市规模，预留了空地，还有将来扩展外城的规模。
这些难民也有地方待。
林恩舒展了一下自己的身体，再次感叹了现在的处境：“硝石如何大量获得是问题，矿也是问题，怎么大量炼铁，如何量产，火帽怎么制作，雷管怎么制作，能用蒸汽机怎么制作，受不了，就我一个人搞科研，那有那么多的精力啊！。”
这些都是林恩面临的问题
硝石在约翰牛那里还出现过收集全国尿液的故事，这就说明了这东西提取是要技术的，不是随随便便就能大量获取。
虽然说这个世界是魔法符文时代，魔法符文时代之前是钢铁时代，可是，这并不代表他们有高炉炼铁技术。
百炼钢听过没？
异世界人力大砖飞，一个个跟个牲口一样，直接把钢给你敲出来。
所谓的钢铁时代，也只不过是炼钢技术得到了改进，人类开源了，加上矮人这群家伙真tm的给力，全族疯狂给生产钢铁。
其他的技术更加不用提了。
林恩想想就头大。
好在自己是知道有一些技术肯定能成功的，只要往那个方向研究就绝对没错。

魔法的火焰威力也点刚好在融化铜的那个地步，融化铁基本不可能，更不用提钢铁了。
大量得到钢铁，以及可以量产的火药，火帽，才是林恩最需要的。
“林恩，你在做什么啊？”莉莉姆趁着没有外人，来到了林恩旁边，看林恩做事情。
“想未来的规模，以及如何加速发展。”林恩写着东西。
“你还有空做未来规划啊，我跟你说个事呗。”
“怎么了？”
“你有办法守住吗？”莉莉姆说这句话的十分没有底气：“那个炸药包数量太少了，也就十几个，标枪这东西，大家历史都有好几十万年了，让他们大量列装射程也是问题，我们这里还聚集了那么多人，我在难民那里打听到隔壁草原来了一个大部落。”
莉莉姆喝了口水：“足足有上万人，大月狼人，之前还打败了虎亚人的黄金军队，现在他们估计有甲了。”
“你想想啊，一群有甲的狼人，他们还有萨满法师。”
“所以啊，林...唔唔~”
林恩掐起莉莉姆的脸：“放心好了，我又不是那种只会靠科技优势，打赢战争的人。”
“我虽然还暂时无法兑现我的科技，不过我有优秀的政体，以及我的微操。”
“我还有我的计谋。”
“接下来，我会让你知道，为什么我说贵族们打架全部都是过家家。”
“由于魔法斗气的存在，个人主义大发展，以一敌千是可以做到的，这就导致大家的打仗全都是靠勇气，聪明点的无非就是会结阵而已。”
“真正的打仗，是需要有超强的纪律性，如何以少胜多，如何使用智慧的力量，而不是勇气。”
最近的林恩，本来就因为破灭黄毛，心情每一天都在不好，战犯指数都每天增加，现在压力大起来了，每一个人都在向自己施加压力。
林恩没有一处地方可以释放压力。
世界上最幸福的两件事情就是。
content_en:
In the past few days, Lin En has been writing his own plan for "Building a Slime Factory from Detoxification to Stringing and Making Cloth".
Lin En wrote several pages in a leisurely manner, and she wrote until late every night when she had time.
These past few days have been very tiring. Fortunately, I could play everything back then.
There are the three dimensions of industrial economy, the four hearts of war, the stars in outer space, the cross in the Middle Ages where you can marry your own daughter, the European continent from the Middle Ages to modern times, and the city-scale skyline.
As well as micro-management games such as Total War and Mount and Cut.
This is a cunning Western political game in the Ice Age.
Let Lin know a little bit about everything.
In addition, as a nobleman in this life, he has been trained in political management skills since childhood.
When the city of Aninsbay was originally designed, the city scale was planned, open space was reserved, and the scale of the outer city would be expanded in the future.
These refugees also have a place to stay.
Lin En stretched his body and lamented the current situation again: "How to obtain saltpeter in large quantities is a problem, ore is also a problem, how to smelt iron in large quantities, how to mass produce, how to make flash caps, how to make detonators, how to make steam engines, I can't stand it, I am the only one doing scientific research, so I have so much energy!"
These are the problems faced by Lynn
Saltpeter also appeared in John Bull's story of collecting urine from across the country, which shows that the extraction of saltpeter requires technology and cannot be obtained casually in large quantities.
Although this world is said to be in the Age of Magical Runes, and before the Age of Magical Runes was the Age of Steel, this does not mean that they have blast furnace ironmaking technology.
Have you ever heard of Baisteel?
In another world, huge bricks of manpower are flying, each one is like an animal, knocking steel out for you.
The so-called steel age is just that the steel-making technology has been improved, humans have open sourced it, and the dwarves are really awesome, and the whole family is crazy about producing steel.
Not to mention other technologies.
Linn felt dizzy just thinking about it.
Fortunately, I know that there are some technologies that will definitely be successful. As long as I research in that direction, I am absolutely right.
The power of the magical flames is just right at the point where it can melt copper. It is basically impossible to melt iron, let alone steel.
Obtaining a large amount of steel, as well as gunpowder and flash caps that can be mass-produced are what Linn needs most.
"Lynn, what are you doing?" Lilim came to Linn's side while there were no outsiders, watching Linn do something.
“Think about future scale and how to accelerate growth,” Lynn wrote.
"You still have time to make future plans. Let me tell you something."
"What's wrong?"
"Do you have a way to hold on?" Lilim said this without confidence: "The number of explosive packs is too small, only a dozen. We have javelins for hundreds of thousands of years. It is also a problem to let them install a large number of ranges. We have so many people gathered here. I asked the refugees that a large tribe has come to the grassland next door."
Lilim took a sip of water: "There are tens of thousands of people, the Great Moon Werewolf. They defeated the golden army of the Huya before, but now they probably have armor."
"Think about it, a group of armored werewolves, and they also have shamans."
"So, Lin... uh uh~"
Linn pinched Lilim's face: "Don't worry, I'm not the kind of person who only relies on technological advantages to win wars."
"Although I can't realize my technology yet, I have an excellent political system and my micro management."
"I still have my own plan."
"Next, I will let you know why I said that all fights between nobles are just playing house."
"Due to the existence of magical fighting spirit and the great development of individualism, it is possible to fight one against a thousand. This leads to the fact that everyone relies on courage to fight. The smarter ones just know how to form formations."
"Real fighting requires super discipline. How toTo win more with less, how to use the power of wisdom instead of courage. "
Recently, Lin En was in a bad mood every day because of his disillusionment, and his war criminal index was increasing every day. Now he is under great pressure, and everyone is putting pressure on himself.
Lynn doesn't have a place to release her stress.
The two happiest things in the world are.
